categories.name: Admission to Non-Critical Ward
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an inpatient non-critical ward. Advances the patient along the disposition path and is typically measured by downstream post-discharge outcomes.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Admission NC (id=15) under the OR-decomposition of goal 5. Supported by frequent and rare variants like V0008, V0625, and V0068 where Admission NC realizes the inpatient ward admission.

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care inpatient ward. Associated with intensive care management and carries a negative contribution to minimizing time-to-treatment (SomeNegative -25).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Admission IC (id=16) under the OR-decomposition of goal 5. Supported by narrative evidence in variants like V0605, V0317, and V0710 where patients are routed to intensive care.
